name: Playwright MCP
description: Browser automation tools for opening sites, clicking elements, filling forms, and extracting page data with Playwright.

browserChannel.description: Preferred browser channel. Defaults to msedge and falls back to chrome.

headless.description: Run the browser headlessly. Defaults to false.

userDataDir.description: Absolute path for the persistent Playwright user profile.

navigationTimeoutMs.description: Navigation timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000.

actionTimeoutMs.description: Action timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000.

viewportWidth.description: Browser viewport width in pixels. Defaults to 1440.

viewportHeight.description: Browser viewport height in pixels. Defaults to 900.
